canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 5,218 FHA applications Plains Commerce Bank acted on ended without a credit decision: 30.0% withdrawn by the applicant and 0.1% closed for incompleteness.

required_qualifiers.population: Plains Commerce Bank FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate; process, market, applicant pool and reporting practice are not separable in the record

does_not_establish: that Plains Commerce Bank's process causes applicants to withdraw, or that its applicants cause files to close
that Plains Commerce Bank is better or worse than another lender for a given applicant
Plains Commerce Bank discriminates or violates law
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
